parsedVerdict.reasoning: The application module has two files serving one concern: task-management use cases. errors.ts only defines NotFoundError, an error used by the application layer. task-service.ts holds TaskService and its input types (DTOs). Storage is reached only through the injected domain repository interfaces. Checking that a project exists lives in one place, the private requireProject, which both createTask and listProjectTasks reuse. Completing a task goes to the domain method task.markDone() and is not copied into the service. One inconsistency is minor: a missing assignee in createTask throws DomainError("Assignee does not exist") instead of NotFoundError. This can be defended as validating the command's input (a bad reference in a create request) rather than looking up the resource being addressed. So it is not a clear bypass or duplicated rule.
